summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MedMatch membership system, role selection, payment options, and recruiter job posting features. Fixed critical bug where /api/auth/me and /api/auth/login endpoints were not returning user role, preventing recruiters from accessing job posting UI.

minor.issue: Returns 520 error due to paypalrestsdk library import issues - expected since PayPal credentials not configured

issues: Stripe 'Pay $1 with Card' button may be cut off on smaller viewports - consider adjusting card height

context_for_next_testing_agent: Membership system fully tested. Role selection works during registration. Job seekers get 15-day trial, recruiters get free active membership.
